<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_MarketingCampaign">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Marketing" name="Marketing team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Process</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineObjectives</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateContent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DesignVisuals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectChannels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LaunchCampaign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CampaignActivitiesSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TrackPerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CampaignPeriodEnds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CampaignActivitiesJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnalyzePerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Process</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CRM" name="CRM system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectLeads</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sales" name="Sales team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FollowUpLeads</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Campaign planning begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives, audience, and goals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design campaign visuals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesSplit" name="Run campaign activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in CRM"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpLeads" name="Follow up with leads"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" name="Campaign period ends">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesJoin" name="Campaign period ends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze performance for future optimization"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Campaign analysis complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_DefineObjectives" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DefineObjectives_CreateContent" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateContent_DesignVisuals" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignVisuals_SelectChannels" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectChannels_LaunchCampaign" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaunchCampaign_Split" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_TrackPerformance" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CollectLeads" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CampaignPeriodEnds" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectLeads_FollowUp" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_FollowUpLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackPerformance_Join" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUp_Join" sourceRef="Task_FollowUpLeads" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PeriodEnds_Join" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_AnalyzePerformance" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignActivitiesJoin" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnalyzePerformance_End" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
